start.line: Six steps to a website chat that answers, and a pipeline that follows up.
start.title: Get started

widget.title: Put the chat on your website
widget.line: Copy one line into your site; visitors can write to you from every page.

assistant.title: Give the assistant its voice
assistant.line: Its name, tone and what it may promise, so it speaks like your team.

knowledge.title: Teach it your answers
knowledge.line: At least five questions and answers, or a document with your prices and hours.

reply.title: Answer your first chat
reply.line: Take a chat over from the assistant in the inbox and reply as a person.

pipeline.title: Set up your pipeline
pipeline.line: The stages a lead goes through, from first contact to won.

team.title: Invite a colleague
team.line: Share the inbox: everyone sees who is answering which chat.

start.complete: Everything is set up. Your chat answers, and your pipeline follows up.
start.list_line: Each step is ticked by itself once it is done.
